summary_zh: QWERTY 键盘布局由报人肖尔斯在 1870 年代初设计，1874 年随雷明顿打字机上市，1878 年雷明顿 2 号流行后一直沿用到今天的电脑键盘。
summary_en: Christopher Sholes devised the QWERTY layout in the early 1870s; it shipped on Remington typewriters from 1874 and, after the 1878 Remington No. 2, became the standard still used on computers.
